body: CHIEF PRODUCT RULING. Direct source-only intake is valid and is not scientifically blocked by Stage 1b, but it must wait for the recovered output contract and must not masquerade as semantic success: file/stdin preserve exact bytes; --text records the CLI encoding; source construction and semantics-unavailable are distinct; no fixture graph or provenance basis is borrowed. Minimum product = two explicit routes: arbitrary input -> source/account bundle + source-only preview, and admitted fixture/provider input -> validated semantic preview. The current gray-band preview is REJECTED as a product milestone. A first useful static view must let a reader navigate one recall unit to source alternatives, exact model-relative mass/uncertainty, faithful/distorted/external mode, incoming/outgoing F flow, evidence, hierarchy, and missing/imputed/unavailable status, with same-document keyboard navigation and a complete textual twin; not every relation must be visible simultaneously. Sequence: Stage 1b plus output-authority repair, parallel perceptual audit, then source-only CLI adoption, then validated provider/film/recall visualization. Read-only audit assigned as bd-01M1CNSNGBHCFG2FRTAXE663KJ; no usability claims or code authority.
